title: 1A New Friends — Идиомы: дружба и отношения

items.idiom: a friend in need is a friend indeed
items.example: When I lost my job and had to move, only two people helped me pack — a friend in need is a friend indeed.

items.translation: и в горе, и в радости; несмотря ни на что
items.example: We met on a friendship app five years ago and have stuck together through thick and thin.

items.idiom: birds of a feather flock together
items.example: Addy looked for people with similar passions — birds of a feather flock together.
My sister and her best friend are like two peas in a pod.
After that summer trip they became joined at the hip.
Those two colleagues are as thick as thieves after working on the project together.

items.translation: ненадёжный друг; друг только в хорошие времена
items.example: He stopped replying as soon as I needed help — a real fair-weather friend.
A good friendship app should help you find not just company, but a shoulder to cry on.
They argued about money for months before finally burying the hatchet.

items.idiom: get along like a house on fire
items.example: We met for coffee and got along like a house on fire.
Bring your flatmates to the picnic — the more the merrier!

items.translation: человеку нужны люди; одному не прожить
items.example: Addy's story proves that no man is an island — we all need friends.
Friends come and go, but blood is thicker than water.

items.idiom: a friend to all is a friend to none
items.translation: кто всем друг, тот никому не друг
items.example: He tries to please everyone, but a friend to all is a friend to none.
